items.quote: Not accuracy benchmarks, but behaviour benchmarks.
items.statement: Benchmarking different LLMs in Trainer Twin focuses on behavior benchmarks rather than accuracy.

items.quote: They behaved like completely different interviewers.
items.statement: Models behaved like different interviewers under the same conditions.
Test involved 25 models and 1,613 total turns in 5 interview scenarios.

items.quote: Gemini 3.6 Flash was the strongest overall interviewer. Detailed feedback, technically relevant follow-ups, and good tool use.
items.statement: Gemini 3.6 Flash was strong overall with detailed feedback and technically relevant follow-ups.

items.quote: But it also had some protocol-level errors.
GPT-5.6 Luna was the most reliable. Concise, disciplined and consistent. Good second-order questions, stayed in character.
items.statement: GPT-5.6 Luna was reliable and consistent, with disciplined behavior and good second-order questions.

items.quote: GPT-4o was fluent and natural, with the fastest first-token latency among the non-Qwen models. But it sometimes wasn’t listening.
items.statement: GPT-4o was fluent but struggled with relevant listening, sometimes suggesting coding exercises during system design interviews.

items.quote: sometimes leaked <thinking> tags into the output.
items.statement: Claude Haiku occasionally leaked internal tags into output.

items.quote: Qwen 3.7 Flash was the fastest model I tested at around half a second to first token.
items.statement: Qwen 3.7 Flash was the fastest model tested.

items.quote: DeepSeek was slow and frequently hit the token cap. Mimo had similar tool issues. Inkling sometimes returned serialized tool requests as visible text.
items.statement: DeepSeek was slow and frequently hit the token cap, Mimo had similar tool issues, and Inkling sometimes returned serialized tool requests as visible text.

items.quote: Does it stay in character? That's when you start evaluating behaviour, not intelligence.
items.statement: Start evaluating models for their behavior, not intelligence, to build effective AI versions of professionals.

overview: Benchmarking observations of LLMs in Trainer Twin, focusing on behavior rather than accuracy.
